build_task_template: build a PHyRE task template with a ball and obstacle bars using creator_lib
create_static_bar: create a static bar obstacle with configurable angle, position, and scale in the scene
create_dynamic_ball: create a dynamic ball object with configurable position and scale in the scene
update_task_relationships: update the task to define a TOUCHING spatial relationship between the ball and bar
set_solution_tier: set the solution tier metadata for the task to BALL tier
